title: German Potato Gratin
description: A classic German dish featuring thinly sliced potatoes, onions, and a creamy earthy sauce, perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they're softened and caramelized, stirring occasionally.
In a separate saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes, flour, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the heavy cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the potatoes are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Top with a layer of caramelized onions, followed by a sprinkle of Gruyère cheese.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
